questions.stem: Complete the sentence: We ___ more time; the report is incomplete.
questions.explanation: Should have + past participle criticizes a past decision.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: She ___ the meeting; she was in the office all day.
questions.explanation: Can’t have + past participle expresses impossibility about the past.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: I need to ___ my car repaired.
questions.explanation: Have something done means arrange for a service.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? She ___ her hair cut yesterday.
questions.explanation: The past causative is had + object + past participle.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: We ___ the office cleaned every Friday.
questions.explanation: Have the office cleaned means arrange the cleaning.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: He ___ his suit cleaned before the interview.
questions.explanation: Had his suit cleaned is the past causative.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: They ___ the contract reviewed by a lawyer.
questions.explanation: Had the contract reviewed means arranged a review.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: I wish I ___ more time.
questions.explanation: Wish + past simple describes an unreal present situation.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: She wishes she ___ the offer.
questions.explanation: Wish + past perfect describes a past regret.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: If only we ___ the earlier train.
questions.explanation: If only + past perfect expresses a past regret.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: I wish it ___ raining.
questions.explanation: Wish + would describes a desired change.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? They wish they ___ in a bigger office.
questions.explanation: Wish + past simple describes an unreal present situation.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: Never ___ I seen such a good report.
questions.explanation: After never at the start, invert the subject and auxiliary: have I.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: Rarely ___ we receive such positive feedback.
questions.explanation: After rarely, use do + subject + base verb.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: Not only ___ she finish the project, but she also helped the team.
questions.explanation: Not only at the start triggers inversion with did.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: Hardly ___ we started when the client called.
questions.explanation: Hardly + had + subject + past participle.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? Seldom ___ he miss a deadline.
questions.explanation: Seldom at the start triggers inversion with does.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: ___ the strong criticism, the plan went ahead.
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a noun phrase.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: ___ it was raining, we went to the client meeting.
questions.explanation: Although is followed by a clause.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? She passed the exam ___ not studying much.
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a gerund phrase.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: ___ hard he tried, he could not solve the problem.
questions.explanation: However + adjective + subject + verb.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: We continued the project ___ the budget cuts.
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a noun phrase.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: We sent the report early ___ the client could review it.
questions.explanation: So that is followed by a clause with could.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: She called ___ confirm the meeting.
questions.explanation: To + infinitive expresses purpose.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: He saved money ___ buy a new laptop.
questions.explanation: To + infinitive expresses purpose.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? We left early ___ avoid the traffic.
questions.explanation: To + infinitive expresses purpose.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: The manager explained the policy ___ everyone understood it.
questions.explanation: So that introduces a purpose clause.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: The demand was so high ___ we had to hire more staff.
questions.explanation: So + adjective + that introduces a result clause.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? It was such a long meeting ___ everyone was tired.
questions.explanation: Such + noun phrase + that introduces a result clause.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: The system failed, ___ caused a delay.
questions.explanation: Which refers back to the whole previous clause.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: Sales increased, ___ we expanded the team.
questions.explanation: So introduces a result.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: The report was incomplete; ___, we could not approve it.
questions.explanation: Therefore introduces a result.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: ___ the report, she sent it to the manager.
questions.explanation: Having + past participle shows an earlier completed action.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: ___ by the delay, the client complained.
questions.explanation: The past participle describes how the client felt.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: ___ the budget, we left the meeting.
questions.explanation: Having discussed shows the action was completed first.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: ___ from the top, the office looks small.
questions.explanation: The past participle is used in a passive sense.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: ___ the news, he called the client.
questions.explanation: The present participle describes an action happening at the same time.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: She asked me ___ I had finished the report.
questions.explanation: Whether introduces a reported yes/no question.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: He asked ___ the meeting would start.
questions.explanation: When introduces a reported wh-question about time.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: They asked me ___ I could help.
questions.explanation: If introduces a reported yes/no question.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? She wanted to know ___ the client had called.
questions.explanation: Whether introduces a reported yes/no question.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: He asked me ___ I was working on.
questions.explanation: What introduces a reported wh-question.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: My manager, ___ has worked here for ten years, is retiring.
questions.explanation: A non-defining clause about a person uses who.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: The report ___ I sent yesterday was approved.
questions.explanation: A defining clause about a thing can use that.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: Our office, ___ is on the fifth floor, has a great view.
questions.explanation: A non-defining clause about a thing uses which.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: The candidate ___ CV impressed us was hired.
questions.explanation: Whose shows possession.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: The city ___ we opened our new branch is growing fast.
questions.explanation: Where refers to a place.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: By next year, she ___ her degree.
questions.explanation: By next year describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? By the end of the month, we ___ the project.
questions.explanation: By the end of the month requires the future perfect.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: They ___ the new system by June.
questions.explanation: By June marks completion before a future deadline.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: By 2030, the company ___ into three new markets.
questions.explanation: By 2030 requires the future perfect.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: He ___ the report by the time you arrive.
questions.explanation: By the time you arrive marks a future deadline.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: The manager insisted that the report ___ submitted today.
questions.explanation: Insist that + subject + base verb uses the subjunctive.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: It is essential that everyone ___ the safety rules.
questions.explanation: Essential that + subject + base verb uses the subjunctive.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: The board recommended that she ___ the position.
questions.explanation: Recommend that + subject + base verb uses the subjunctive.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? If I ___ you, I would apologize.
questions.explanation: If I were you is a fixed subjunctive form.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: It is important that he ___ informed immediately.
questions.explanation: Important that + subject + be uses the subjunctive.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: She can swim, and so ___ I.
questions.explanation: So + auxiliary + subject echoes can swim.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: He wasn't at the meeting, and neither ___ she.
questions.explanation: Neither + auxiliary + subject echoes the past be.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? I asked him to help, but he didn’t ___.
questions.explanation: Ellipsis after to leaves the infinitive marker.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: She said she would call, but she didn't ___.
questions.explanation: The substitute verb do replaces the earlier verb phrase.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: They finished the work, and we ___ too.
questions.explanation: Did substitutes for finished the work in the past.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: It was the manager ___ approved the budget.
questions.explanation: A cleft sentence about a person uses who.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: It is the customer service ___ needs improvement.
questions.explanation: A cleft sentence about a thing can use that.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: What I need is ___ time to finish the report.
questions.explanation: A wh-cleft uses the comparative more here.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: It was in 2020 ___ the company launched the product.
questions.explanation: The cleft structure uses that after the time phrase.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: The person ___ I spoke to was the supplier.
questions.explanation: Who refers to a person.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: ___ you finish the report, we can submit it today.
questions.explanation: Provided that means on condition that.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? I will attend ___ I am not ill.
questions.explanation: Unless means if not.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: ___ it rains, the event will go ahead.
questions.explanation: Unless introduces an exception.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: We will proceed ___ we receive written approval.
questions.explanation: Provided that introduces a condition.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? ___ you need help, call me.
questions.explanation: If introduces a condition.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: She likes coffee, and so ___ I.
questions.explanation: So + do + subject echoes a present simple verb.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: He didn't attend, and neither ___ she.
questions.explanation: Neither + did + subject echoes the past simple.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: They have finished, and so ___ we.
questions.explanation: So + have + subject echoes the present perfect.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: I can't swim, and neither ___ he.
questions.explanation: Neither + can + subject echoes the modal.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: We were late, and so ___ they.
questions.explanation: So + were + subject echoes the past be.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? ___ the proposal, the board asked for changes.
questions.explanation: Having + past participle shows an earlier completed action.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: ___ the client before, he knew what to expect.
questions.explanation: Having met shows an earlier experience.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: ___ for hours, they finally reached an agreement.
questions.explanation: Having negotiated shows the action was completed first.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: ___ the risks, the board approved the plan.
questions.explanation: Having considered shows a completed prior action.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: ___ the email, she realized her mistake.
questions.explanation: Having sent shows the action was completed before the realization.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: The report ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: Modal passive = modal + be + past participle.

questions.stem: Choose the correct option: The issue ___ immediately.
questions.explanation: Should be + past participle is the passive form.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? The contract ___ by both parties.
questions.explanation: The contract receives the action: must be signed.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: The data ___ securely.
questions.explanation: The data receives the action: should be stored.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: The meeting ___ until next week.
questions.explanation: The meeting receives the action: can be postponed.

questions.stem: Fill in the blank: The more we practice, ___ we become.
questions.explanation: The more..., the better... is a double comparative.

questions.stem: Select the best answer: This year's results are ___ better than last year's.
questions.explanation: Slightly modifies a comparative.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: The new process is ___ efficient than the old one.
questions.explanation: Considerably modifies a comparative.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? She is ___ most experienced manager in the team.
questions.explanation: Superlatives take the.

questions.stem: Which option is correct? The harder you work, ___ you will achieve.
questions.explanation: The harder..., the more... is a double comparative.
